title: Say Inmunan Dala ya Inkalbo ed Imon
intro: Isipen pa so sankaunaan iran agew na katooan, sanen say interon mundo et saksakey a pamilya. Nanengneng mo so duaran apay ya inyan ed arap nen Allah — say sakey et inawat, say sananey et ag. Say imon et onlamot ed puso, tan say panamagyaw et ibubulong ed sanok. Say ontumbok et mangitilak na marka ed awaran ed andi-anggaan, tan anggan say melag a manok et magmaliw a managbangat.
clues: Kabiangan ak ed sankaunaan a pamilya ed dalin.
Angiter ak na apay ed si Allah, balet ag inawat so apay ko legan ya inawat so sananey ya apay.
Nansalita ak lapud imon tan tinakot kon pateyen koy sakey a too.
Ginawa ko so sankaunaan ya agmakatunongan a panagpatey ed dalin.
Anengneng koy sakey ya uwak ya mankukuskos ed dalin pian ipanengneng tod siak no panon ya iyamot so bangkay.
Napno ak na pagbabawi tan nagmaliw ak a sakey ed saray abalang lapud ginawa na saray limak.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Qabil (Cain), ya anak nen Adan
Samiri, say nanggawa na kilaw a baka
Si Namrud, say managpairap ya akisangsangan ed si Ibrahim
si Azar, say managgaway talintaoy diriyos
Kan'an, say nalner ya anak nen Nuh

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Pamatey ed sakey ya agi lapud imon kayari na ag-inawat ya apay
Manggawa na atagey a tori pian nanengneng so katawenan
Manggawa na balitok a kilaw a baka parad panagdayew
Mankekerew na lamisaan ya akaunat manlapud tawen
Mangidaulo na armada na saray elepante pian deralen so Kaaba
trial.answer: Pamatey ed sakey ya agi lapud imon kayari na ag-inawat ya apay

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey ya uwak ya mankukuskos ed dalin pian ipanengneng so ponpon
Sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka ya inmepas
Sakey a baleg a biong ed tapew na delap
Sakey a baston a nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a lamisaan ya akapeket so naakan a nanlapud tawen
location.answer: Sakey ya uwak ya mankukuskos ed dalin pian ipanengneng so ponpon

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nagmaliw ya maermen tan sakey ed saray abalang
Nalner ed baleg a delap
Inakmon na dalin a walaan na kayamanan
Pitoy taon ya asagmak na kating
Niiter so sakey a panarian a walaan na panangontrol ed saray dagem
outcome.answer: Nagmaliw ya maermen tan sakey ed saray abalang

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
